SIHI contributes to the implementation of the WHO framework for people -centred integrated health services and 
of the WHO community engagement framework, which are critical elements to reach universal health coverage an d 
leave no one behind.  
Gender equity has been especially looked at when establishing external review panels, convening experts, issuing 
contracts, and in general within our collaborations. The next step is to explore the development of research grant 
schemes to enhance social innovation in health care delivery, specifically: (i) for women and child health; and (ii) 
led by women.
